channel.title: Comments for page "We Just Make Toys"
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "We Just Make Toys"

item.content:encoded:
i can not tell you how long i have been waiting for this to hit +100.

There it is. My first +100 tale. Wow. I am. Elated. And on the same day that I'm gonna go to a protest in Sacramento, a day after my friend got stitches for axing himself in the leg, and the same day that my friend is doing his first day of work ever. Isn't it strange how life is just… so jampacked with events? Like, if life has this many things happening, day in and day out, till the day I die, that'd be fucking wack. You know?

Anyways, enough existential joy (the opposite of existential dread!), thank you all for +100!! Super happy about this, can't believe the amount of people that have read and liked this tale and also this series as a whole. Makes my heart beat faster and my mouth smile wider.

item.content:encoded:
Some mixed feelings on this. A lot of the paragraphs could have benefited from some breaking up. Stuff done in Dr. Wondertainment's Wacky-Prose-A-Rooty-Tooty ™ style quickly becomes grating to read, and this was no exception.

However, the tonal whiplash that came with the narrator's anger about halfway through benefited greatly from that same grating-ness. Very well done, imo.

Overall, I wasn't blown away, but this piqued my interest and I look forward to reading more.

There are a few inconsistent pronouns. For instance, Polly is "they" in the first sentence to describe her, and "she" thereafter. The baby assistant likewise goes from "they" to "he".

I'm not against using "they" as a gender-neutral 3rd person singular, but please decide what pronoun you're going to use and stuck with it.

"You are not huggable."

I still feel so bad for Polly, especially since Brainy never actually produces any evidence against her.

But also…Tattletale Truffles! Your Call Is Important To Us reference! Some guy's in gitmo because of Brainy! Wooooo!

Good luck with your series. Given this site's track record, whenever I see a whole series listed in advance I'm worried it will become a graveyard of histrionic ambition.

item.content:encoded:
Alright, first tale in the five part series called "Vend-a-Friend"! Don't worry, that title will make sense in time. Say hello to Brainy Brian! I had so much fun writing this (and the rest of it). I hope you guys will like it just as much as I have enjoyed making it.

EDIT: So, many people have read his name as "Brainy Brain". I need to correct this, because, see, it's not that, it's "Brainy Brian". Like the name. like Brian Harding. Anyways, with that out of the way, onto something more important…

There's now a reading of this, by me, available here! It's taylor_itkin's new podcast called Author's Corner where tales get the spotlight they right and truly deserve. By popular vote (and because Doctor Cimmerian was unable to show up due to personal conflicts, you can read the tale that was actually most popularly voted on here) the first chapter of Vend-a-Friend was asked to be on the podcast. Everybody who has read and enjoyed this chapter should definitely go hear me read it and then answer questions (sometimes about it, sometimes just in general). Huzzah!
